days.rollupZh: 今日，Anthropic 公布用 Claude 加速药物研发的早期进展，同时外界也在追问其真实定位与上市动向。OpenAI 方面则宣布扩大与甲骨文的合作、把甲骨文应用引入 ChatGPT，并展示 Retell、Check Point、Greptile 等伙伴的使用案例。技术圈另有树莓派新品线索、离线应急 AI 助手，以及关于 AI 日常危害与智能体级 Git 基础设施的讨论。
days.rollupEn: Anthropic shared early progress on using Claude for drug development, while coverage also questioned what the company really is amid IPO talk. OpenAI expanded its Oracle partnership to bring Oracle apps into ChatGPT and highlighted work by Retell, Check Point, and Greptile. Other items include leaked Raspberry Pi models, an offline survival AI assistant, and discussions of everyday AI harms and agent-scale Git infrastructure.
